title: Flair challenges Bischoff’s authority
summary: Ric Flair’s return reconnects him with the Horsemen and turns his conflict with Eric Bischoff into a struggle over WCW’s leadership. The executive is forced to defend his power in the ring.

chapters.title: Flair returns with the Horsemen
chapters.result: Flair returns during the Horsemen reunion.
chapters.context: His emotional confrontation with Bischoff becomes the public face of their authority feud.

chapters.title: Flair wins control of WCW
chapters.result: Flair defeats Bischoff to become WCW president for 90 days.
chapters.context: After the previous night’s setback, the rematch transfers on-screen authority to Flair.
